brief.offer_summary: iPhone, Mac, iPad and Watch, sold direct with trade-in and carrier financing.
brief.target_audience: Existing Apple owners on a two to three year upgrade cycle, plus Android switchers in their twenties and thirties.

channels.rationale: Launch films live here, and the audience searches for them by name within the hour.
Camera claims are judged here first. Reels carry the format the audience already watches.
Upgrade cycles are argued out in public here, and the younger half of the buyer sits on it.
r/apple and the carrier subreddits settle upgrade decisions before anyone reaches a store.
Fast reach around launch events, though targeting has degraded and waste runs higher.
Cheapest incremental reach in the set. Weak on brand, right for retargeting the visits.

brief.offer_summary: Footwear and apparel sold direct, with member-only drops and free returns.
brief.target_audience: Runners and sneaker buyers from their late teens to mid thirties, in cities, who buy on release day.

channels.rationale: Athlete and product photography carry here, and saves predict launch-day traffic.
Sneaker culture runs on this platform, and drops are discussed before they ship.
Long-form brand films and athlete documentaries, where the story outlives the flight.
Reaches the teenage half of the buyer that no longer opens the other apps.
r/Sneakers verifies authenticity and resale value, which decides the mid-tier purchase.
Cheapest way back to a cart that was abandoned at checkout.

brief.offer_summary: Streaming films and series across four tiers, including an ad-supported plan.
brief.target_audience: Households already paying for two streaming services, and lapsed subscribers who left after a season ended.

channels.rationale: Trailers are watched here by choice, and view-through predicts a first episode.
Scenes are clipped and argued about here within hours of a release.
Cast-led promotion, where a title travels on a face rather than a logline.
Show subreddits sustain attention between seasons better than any paid flight.
Live reaction through a premiere window, useful for a launch beat and little else.
Retargeting lapsed subscribers against a specific title rather than the service.

brief.offer_summary: Music and podcasts on a free tier or Premium, with a student rate and family plans.
brief.target_audience: Free-tier listeners who hit the skip limit, and students eligible for the discounted plan.

channels.rationale: A sound becomes a search. This is the shortest path from a clip to a stream.
Story shares of playlists behave like word of mouth with a measurable click.
Music video watch time marks a listener who is not yet paying for a subscription.
Genre communities argue catalogue depth and audio quality, and they convert.
Reaches students during the window when the discount actually matters.
Retargeting the trial page, the cheapest way back to someone who nearly signed up.

brief.offer_summary: Payments, billing and payouts for internet businesses, priced per transaction.
brief.target_audience: Engineering and finance leads at companies processing their first million in payments.

channels.rationale: Finance and engineering leaders both sit here, and this is a two-signature purchase.
Integration questions are asked here first, which is the moment of highest intent.
r/SaaS and r/webdev compare processors openly, including on fees.
One unobtrusive unit across developer publications. Cheap endemic reach.
Integration walkthroughs and conference talks, for capture once the category is understood.
Founders and engineering leads still congregate here around launches.

brief.offer_summary: Electric vehicles ordered online, with delivery scheduling and no dealership.
brief.target_audience: Households replacing a second car, who have already run the charging maths and read the range tests.

channels.rationale: Range tests and ownership reviews decide this purchase more than any ad does.
Owner subreddits carry the service and software complaints that shape consideration.
Design-led imagery, which is what separates the car from its spec sheet.
The category's conversation still starts here, for better and worse.
Delivery-day content reaches the younger buyer years before they can buy.
Retargeting a configurator session that never reached a deposit.

brief.offer_summary: Stays and experiences booked direct from hosts, with flexible dates and free cancellation.
brief.target_audience: Travellers planning two to three trips a year who compare a stay against a hotel on total cost.

channels.rationale: Destination imagery is the product. Saves here lead bookings by weeks.
Trip planning starts months out, and a pin holds intent far longer than a click.
Stay tours travel further than any listing photo, and they name the city.
Travel vlogs, where a neighbourhood sells itself before a price is seen.
Broad retargeting against a search that has already happened.
City subreddits answer where to stay, and they distrust anything sponsored.

brief.offer_summary: Restaurant and grocery delivery, with a subscription that removes the delivery fee.
brief.target_audience: City households ordering twice a week who currently pay per-order fees on a rival app.

channels.rationale: Food content converts on impulse, and the order can happen in the same minute.
Restaurant partners already post here, so half the creative exists before the buy.
Cheapest reach for a promotion that only needs to arrive before dinner.
Campus reach during the hours when the discount decides the order.
Bumper formats for a category that needs reminding, not explaining.
City subreddits discuss fees openly, which is the objection to answer.
